    FROM accounts a

    JOIN interaction_metrics im ON a.acct_ref = im.acct_dm
),

    FROM accounts a
    JOIN account_clusters ac ON a.acct_ref = ac.acct_bridge
    JOIN cluster_analysis ca ON ac.clu_ref = ca."CLSTR_PIN"
    GROUP BY a.acct_ref
)
